description:
Research LangChain's support for PostgreSQL/pgvector. I need comprehensive information about:

1. All LangChain integration modules related to PostgreSQL (vector stores, document loaders, chat memory, etc.)
2. Their package names, installation commands, and usage
3. pgvector extension details
4. Community evaluation and usage

Search online for:
- LangChain pgvector integration
- LangChain PostgresChatMessageHistory
- LangChain PostgresLoader (SQL document loader)
- LangChain PostgreSQL vector store
- pgvector + LangChain performance
- All LangChain PostgreSQL-related packages on PyPI

Compile all findings into detailed notes.
